purpose: Conceptual-baseline component responsibilities for requirement-to-component validation. Coverage is evaluated separately.

source.location: Table A-0: Baseline architecture components and sub-components

supplementary_sources.location: Baseline component responsibilities and runtime-flow descriptions
supplementary_sources.architecture_scope: Conceptual baseline, as confirmed by the author

conventions.behaviour_rule: Behaviours represent documented baseline responsibilities, not verified implementations.
conventions.interface_rule: Interfaces represent named interactions; matching names do not prove compatibility. Missing details remain undetermined.
conventions.state_rule: Stateful requires documented stored state. Otherwise, classification is undetermined, not stateless.
conventions.optional_component_rule: Optional components are assessed per requirement or flow; presence is not assumed.
conventions.closed_world_rule: Not documented does not mean absent from all implementations.
conventions.subcomponent_attribution_rule: R7 subcomponent assignments are modeling decisions, not explicit source claims.
conventions.evidence_rule: Coverage requires source evidence and interpretation in capability_mappings.json, not just behaviour names.
